content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-graduation in Basic Sciences/Engineering with 60% aggregate marks/Average (CGPA) 6.5 on a 10-point scale for GEN, and marks will be relaxed by 5% or by a CGPA of 0.5 (on a 10-point scale) for SC/ST/PwD candidates from a UGC recognized University/Institute/Autonomous bodies. Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on 16 November 2026) Other conditions: The selected candidate will be encouraged to join and complete Ph.D. degree at NIT Kurukshetra. Desirable: CSIR/UGC-NET or GATE/GPAT qualification

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NIT Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: NIT Kurukshetra Visiting Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Implement the research project titled "Mid-IR Light Generation in Nonlinear Materials using Four-Wave-Mixing" at the spoke institution, National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra in collaboration with the hub institution, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore (M.P.). Participate in research under Theme 1: Advanced Materials (part of the SAKSHAM project comprising three themes: Theme 1: Advanced Materials; Theme 2: Environmental Sustainability and Energy Technology; and Theme 3: Health and Medical Technologies). Work at the Spoke and Hub institutions as workplace may vary from time to time as per project requirements.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial appointment is up to 30 June 2027, to be continued till September 2029 or co-terminus with the duration of the project based on the performance of the candidate (semester wise).

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: How Will NIT Kurukshetra Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test Interview in Physical Mode at NIT Kurukshetra Selection process consists of a written test and an interview in Physical Mode at NIT Kurukshetra. Candidates who have qualified GATE/NET or any other national level examination are exempted from the written examination.

content_sections.heading: NIT Kurukshetra Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The syllabus for written examination in the respective disciplines is as per their GATE/NET curriculum. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview/written test.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form Copy of all academic documents

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants in the final year of their Master’s programme who have submitted their dissertation/thesis but do not have their final-semester results may apply and must submit results by 31 December 2026.
